data.content:
Donyell Malen is suspended for this game after picking up a red card against Como, while Manu Kone may miss out with a thigh injury.

Genoa failed to win any of their opening five matches, suffering four defeats during that run.

The Griffins finally got off the mark in their last outing, beating Fiorentina 2-1 to secure their first victory of the season.

Their defensive frailties remain a major concern, with Genoa having conceded 11 goals so far this campaign. [...] Roma have picked up only one win in their last five matches, and lost 3-4 against Real Madrid in their last Champions League game.

Gian Piero Gasperini's side are undefeated in the league, but are winless in their other two games, drawing against Inter Milan and Como.

Roma have the best defence in the league along with Cagliari, having conceded only three goals so far. [...] The last meeting between the two sides ended in a 2-1 victory for Genoa, although Roma won 3-1 at the Stadio Olimpico in their most recent home encounter against the Griffins.
